description_en: Queries the data collection configuration of a specified proxy cluster
description_zh: 查询指定代理集群的数据采集配置信息
name: DescribeHybridProxyPolicy

parameters.help_en: The name of the proxy cluster. You can view the cluster name in the console
parameters.help_zh: 代理集群名称，用户可以通过控制台查看集群名称
parameters.name: cluster_name

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page in a paged query
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的数据条数

PolicyList.description_en: The list of data collection configurations for the proxy cluster
PolicyList.description_zh: 代理集群数据采集配置列表

Config.description_en: The specific value of the policy configuration

FileName.description_en: The file to which the data intercepted by the proxy cluster policy is written
FileName.description_zh: 代理集群通过策略拦截的数据写入到指定的文件

Type.description_en:
The configured policy type. Valid values:

file: file data collection
net: network data collection
process: process data collection
Type.description_zh:
配置的策略类型。取值：

file：文件数据采集
net：网络数据采集
process：进程数据采集

PolicyType.description_en:
The policy type. Valid values:

limitFrequency: collection frequency control
limitBandWidth: collection bandwidth control
PolicyType.description_zh:
策略类型。
limitFrequency：采集频率控制
limitBandWidth：采集带宽控制

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
